newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 328 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 328 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 328 contracts compared with 559 overnight Monday.
There were 48 wheat, 122 corn, 107 soybean, nine soymeal, 34 soyoil, three oat and five rice contracts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/4 cent lower to 3/4 higher, corn was steady to 1/2 cent higher and soybeans were steady to 1/2 cent lower.
